title: Walk an in-memory tree
description: Walk an in-memory tree. Files persist until Reset or another example is selected.
source:
import os
from pathlib import Path
walk_root = Path('/work/walk-demo')
walk_root.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
(walk_root / 'nested').mkdir(exist_ok=True)
(walk_root / 'a.txt').write_text('A')
(walk_root / 'nested' / 'b.csv').write_text('B')
print(sorted((os.path.relpath(root, str(walk_root)), sorted(dirs), sorted(files)) for root, dirs, files in os.walk(str(walk_root))))

title: Glob in-memory files
description: Glob in-memory files. Files persist until Reset or another example is selected.
source:
from pathlib import Path
glob_root = Path('/work/glob-demo')
glob_root.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
(glob_root / 'b.csv').write_text('B')
(glob_root / 'a.csv').write_text('A')
(glob_root / 'notes.txt').write_text('notes')
print(sorted(p.name for p in glob_root.glob('*.csv')))

import csv
with open('/work/people.csv', 'w', newline='', encoding='utf-8') as f:
    writer = csv.DictWriter(f, fieldnames=['name', 'age'])
    writer.writeheader()
    writer.writerow({'name': 'Alice', 'age': 30})
with open('/work/people.csv', encoding='utf-8') as f:
